lookback_summary: Well, it was a mixed bag for the model this weekend! It correctly predicted a draw in the Fulham vs. Man United clash, which was a solid call considering it ended 1-1. However, it had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs. Crystal Palace match, where it went for a home win and ended up with a 0-0 draw. The model nailed the banker with Newcastle's win over Hull City, but it got caught out with Everton, and didn't see Aston Villa's away victory over Tottenham coming either. Overall, some hits and misses, but definitely a few surprises to keep us on our toes!
